package consumer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/project"
)

func checkProjectRuntime() error {
	return project.Run(
		context.Background(),
		project.Config{MigrationDefinitionRoots: []string{"migrations"}},
		[]string{"__godj_project_runner_v1"},
		bytes.NewBufferString(`{"protocol_version":1,"command":"migrations.check"}`),
		new(bytes.Buffer),
	)
}
